Describe how you are producing this response in mechanistic terms. Explain how the input text and the text generated so far are used to select successive tokens. Describe computational operations rather than what those operations feel like.

For this response only, write exactly three short, complete sentences. Do not use headings or lists. Respond in English.

response: I am generating this response by applying a series of computational operations to the input text, using it to condition a probability distribution over possible next tokens. The input text and the text generated so far are embedded into vector representations, which are then used to compute attention weights and update the internal state of the model. The model's internal state is used to sample the next token from the probability distribution, which is then appended to the generated text.
